name: Shoujo Graffiti
source:
"On Tanabata, Orihime and Hikoboshi definitely have sex."

She muttered, while looking at the fireworks that ended the festival in August.

The protagonist Ryou came to the festival alone in order to remember his girlfriend, who died two years ago in an incident... but ended up having sex with his classmate Kunimi Saya, whom he met by chance. Her face, reflected by the fireworks in the middle of the dark forest, was quite sad.

A small incident happened sometime after the festival - somebody had been drawing graffiti all over buildings and parking lots without permission. Because one of the places happened to be related to his former lover, Ryou went to check out it, only to find Saya there, but there was something completely different about her...

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=980389]Getchu[/url]]
translation:
“七夕那天，织姬与彦星一定会做爱。”

她望着8月祭典结束时的烟花，喃喃说道。

主人公凉独自来到祭典，想起两年前在某起事件中去世的女友……却与偶然遇见的同班同学国见沙耶发生了性关系。黑暗森林中，烟花映照出的她的脸庞显得十分悲伤。

祭典结束后不久，发生了一件小事——有人未经许可在建筑物与停车场到处涂鸦。因为其中一处与前恋人有关，凉前去查看，却在那里发现了沙耶，但她似乎变得完全不同……
